title: Write a bash script that prints the 5 largest files in a directory.
prompt: Write a bash script that prints the 5 largest files in a directory.
solution_code:
#!/bin/bash
# largest files first
find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf "%s %p\n" \
  | sort -nr \
  | head -5
explanation: Find files with sizes, sort numerically descending, and show the top rows. This pattern works in most codebases.
